description: Cancel a meeting bot that has not joined yet, so it never joins. Use transcription_id for a scheduled bot that already exists, or dispatch_id for one still queued because every bot was busy — a queued dispatch has no transcription and is reachable only by its dispatch_id. list_scheduled_meetings returns both, labelled. Requires `login`.

dispatch_id.description: A dispatch still queued, with no transcription yet.

transcription_id.description: A scheduled bot that already exists.

name: cancel_scheduled_bot
